name: Fair Warning
note: R8.21, Module R2 SSD p.72, titled 'Orion Medium Raider Cruiser' on the sheet. A war cruiser (owner's call on the line) and the most heavily engined Orion for its size: 12+12 warp on a 110-point size-3 hull, where the AR at 100 points carries 10+10 and the BR at 115 carries 12+12. It spends that on engines rather than guns - only six phasers, four Ph-1 forward and two bare-RA Ph-3 aft, where the AR and BR both mount eight. NIMBLE SHIP is printed on it. ITS TRACKS ARE FOUR STEPS, matching the DW rather than the six-step AR: sensor 6/5/1/0, scanner 0/1/5/9, damage control 4/2/2/0. No laboratories. Two centerline mounts, declared adjacent under the silence rule, plus one on each wing. A NOTE ON READING: at thumbnail resolution its FD4.4 line appears to say a maximum of FOUR drones per turn, which would have made it the only exception to the three-rack cap in the fleet; at full resolution it plainly reads THREE, like every other Orion. The cap is standard here. NOT MODELLED: the Y170 plasma carronade and sabot refit (Module R10), the MINELAYER REFIT (R8.R1), and (R8.R3) for option mount firing arcs.
